The research introduces a novel approach to Autonomous Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Real-World Robotic Manipulation by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and Visual Language Models (VLMs). #### 2. Technical Approach

- **Reinforcement Learning Framework**: RL is employed to autonomously optimize robotic actions, complementing the semantic insights from LLMs and VLMs.

- **Task Success Rate**: 85% success rate in executing complex tasks without human intervention.

#### 4. Limitations & Assumptions

- **Computational Complexity**: The integration of LLMs and VLMs increases computational demands, limiting real-time applications.
- **Domain-Specific Limitations**: The approach may not generalize well to entirely new robotic environments or tasks.
